# Purpose
This file records third-party package metadata and license text for the software project. It lists each dependency with its `Name`, `Version`, `License`, `Repository`, `Homepage`, and author data, and it includes the full license notice or copyright text where required. The content supports license compliance, audit work, and dependency tracking by showing which external packages are used and under which terms they are distributed. It also gives a clear source reference for each package so maintainers can review upstream projects and their legal terms.
